records.text: Why are you not concerned? I just need an answer for why they are never concerned. Meryl Gerstenmaier writes, it seems to me Erika (Erika Kirk)'s moral outrage is manufactured more for an elite target audience as opposed to those normal folks who want to solve the actual murder.
records.speaker: Candace Owens
